SELECT A.BND_TTL, A.JEMOK, A.RC_CODE, X.RC_RFILE_NO, X.RC_RITEM_NO, X.ORG_FILE_PATH, X.ORG_FILE_NAME, X.SAVE_FILE_NAME, X.FILE_NAME, NULL AS CONTENTS, X.INDEXING_CONTENTS, X.ZIP_SEQ, X.ZIP_ENTRY_FILE_NAME, X.FILE_TYPE, X.FILE_GUBUN FROM ( SELECT B.RC_RFILE_NO, B.RC_RITEM_NO, B.ORG_FILE_PATH, B.ORG_FILE_NAME, B.SAVE_FILE_NAME, C.FILE_NAME, C.INDEXING_CONTENTS, C.ZIP_SEQ, C.ZIP_ENTRY_FILE_NAME, C.FILE_TYPE, C.FILE_GUBUN FROM EXTRACT_ELEC_DOC C JOIN CN_ELEC_DOC B ON B.RC_RFILE_NO = C.RC_RFILE_NO AND B.RC_RITEM_NO = C.RC_RITEM_NO AND B.SAVE_FILE_NAME = C.FILE_NAME AND B.TRANSFERYEAR = #{transferYear} WHERE C.EXTRACT_STATUS = 'PASS' AND C.INDEXING_CONTENTS IS NOT NULL AND C.INDEXING_CONTENTS != ''
AND (C.LLM_SUMMARY_STATUS IS NULL OR C.LLM_SUMMARY_STATUS != 'PASS')
AND C.LLM_SUMMARY_STATUS IS NULL
ORDER BY C.RC_RFILE_NO, C.RC_RITEM_NO, C.FILE_NAME, C.ZIP_SEQ LIMIT #{limit} ) X JOIN CN_RITEM A ON A.RC_RFILE_NO = X.RC_RFILE_NO AND A.RC_RITEM_NO = X.RC_RITEM_NO ORDER BY X.RC_RFILE_NO, X.RC_RITEM_NO, X.FILE_NAME, X.ZIP_SEQ
